title: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin from 1.0.10 to 1.0.16 does not perform capability checks when creating…
description: The Security For WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions 1.0.10 through 1.0.16 contain a critical vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to create new user accounts without proper capability checks. Attackers can specify the role of the new account, including administrator, enabling full site takeover.
